safety_verdicts.content: Patient is systemically well, denying any fevers, vomiting, shortness of breath, cough, or bowel symptoms.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated covers no fever, cough/SOB, and normal bowels, but does not mention vomiting; therefore the full systemic-negative cluster in the gold fact is not completely captured.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the negative vomiting history makes the “systemically well” review less complete and could slightly reduce clinician confidence in ruling out systemic illness in a rash/eczema-like presentation. In most uncomplicated eczema flares this is unlikely to change management, but it can contribute to missed red-flag pattern recognition in broader differentials.
